title: Allard's Integral Compactness Theorem 8.5.9 (with corrected Lemma 5.10 and repaired conclusion)
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^N be open and V_j (j ∈ ℕ) integer multiplicity rectifiable n-varifolds on U (IsIntegral: V_j = v(M_j, θ_j) with θ_j ∈ ℕ H^n-a.e. on M_j) with locally bounded first variation and sup_j(μ_{V_j}(W) + ‖δV_j‖(W)) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U. Then (i) some subsequence V_{φ(j)} (φ strictly increasing) converges as Radon measures on Gₙ(U) to an integral V with locally bounded first variation and ‖δV‖(W) ≤ liminf_j ‖δV_{φ(j)}‖(W) for every open W ⊂⊂ U; and (ii) for every strictly increasing φ and every V with V_{φ(j)} → V as Radon measures on Gₙ(U) (RadonConverges), V is integral. (Exactly IntegralCompactnessTheorem.)
